Requirements: Training (1) in Lore

You know how to gather data and find your way around a library.

  • You have Advantage on checks to perform research, provided that you have adequate materials available.

  • You have Advantage on checks to gain access to research materials, or determine where the materials may be found.

  • You can read most books in about an hour, though some especially complex or dense tomes may require up to a day.
